shellCommands.command: /bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,220p' app/UserStats.tsx && printf '\\n--- page ---\\n' && sed -n '1,220p' app/page.tsx && printf '\\n--- package ---\\n' && cat package.json && printf '\\n--- agents ---\\n' && find .. -name AGENTS.md -print"
/bin/bash -lc "find app -maxdepth 2 -type f -not -path '*/.next/*' -print | sort && find __agent_eval__ -maxdepth 3 -type f -print 2>/dev/null | sort | head -50"
